ValidationRule.description: All users other then CRP can restrict the case only during the escalation
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint' ), ISCHANGED(IDR_Restriction_Level__c), ISPICKVAL(IDR_Restriction_Level__c , 'Restricted Case'), NOT($UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Resolution_Leadership'), NOT($UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Resolution'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Escalated')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can apply restriction only when the case is escalated
